title: Generalize Organic Path Families
summary: Added a deterministic semantic path planner for direct, diagonal-arc, ordinary-arc, and opposite-corner reconciliation. Candidates derive from motion fields and measured scene geometry, rank canonical motif conformance before collision safety and then reading context and travel, preserve exact seek endpoints, and produce a non-promotable diagnostic when a required canonical route is blocked rather than inventing general routing.
